text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the spring sunlight began to pour down,
the Satsuki Sho had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the opening race of the Classic Triple Crown,
where she had vowed to wage fierce battles alongside her peers—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why was I the only one
who didn't make it in time...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, due to the defeat in the previous GIII race,
Rulership was the only one whose bid
for the Satsuki Sho didn't come true...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I'm sad too. But please, don't let it get you down.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll definitely show everyone
the fathomless strength you possess, Ruler-san—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Then again,
maybe the Japanese Derby is out of the question too...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Who cares about me anyway...?
I'm just a nobody... anyway, dammit!!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dammit! I don't care anymore!
I'm done with joint training too...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Cooped up in my room, rolling alone,
aiming for double hits alone,
alone, alone, alone—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go pout and sleep all by myself~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Aah.
It's because I did such a poor job comforting her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given the position, even consoling them
would be difficult. We just have to wait for Rulership
to stand up on her own.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
He's right.
It's not something you need to worry yourself sick over.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She's right.
It's not something you need to worry yourself sick over.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Besides... knowing Ruler-san's personality, trying to force her to stay right now would be a bad move.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In fact, there's a more effective way.
After the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash concisely explained
that "method" to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah—...
Talk about having the scales fall from my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see, a brilliant idea. ...Regardless of that, though,
we should first focus our efforts on the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This world is not so forgiving
that one can afford to look away.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san will be fine. For now, let's focus on what must be done.
Trainer-san, please take care of things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho, said to be won by the fastest Umamusume. It marks the glorious first race of the Classic Triple Crown series.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Today's featured Umamusume is Victoire Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Her debut race, and then the Hopeful Stakes—her talented running has certainly become quite the talking point.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
However, the other Umamusume in the race aren't backing down either!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Quickly claiming a GⅠ victory after his debut, he fulfilled the long-cherished wish of the Rose Clan.
Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Steadily racking up victories since her debut, Eishin Flash. With her signature instantaneous burst of speed, all eyes are on her as well.

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: Besides them, there are many other highly capable members gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you're nervous...
Fufu, do your best...

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: I'm sure there are many fans eagerly anticipating this year's Classic campaign.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I-I feel like crying...
Damn it, you guys, why do you all have to try so hard...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"—No, hang in there.
No, but... ngh, damn it all...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(First, this one race.
I must demonstrate my strength here.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (In order for the four of us, including Ruler-san, to compete for the ultimate pinnacle...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (To create an even bigger circle—!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: To the summit of victory, let us go!
